card.name: Week and day-count schedule phrases
card.fires_on: Small words right after a number of days and before 'week' or a date, such as 'per', 'each', 'of' and 'day' in schedules like 'for 7 days per week'. Also words inside day-period phrases like '31-day period'.

modes.label: Days per week
modes.description: The linking word between a count of days and 'week' in dosing schedules.
modes.example: ously at a constant rate over 1 hour) once daily for 7 days<< per>> week, or 6 mg/kg once

modes.label: Cycle or period wording
modes.description: Words in day-count or same-day-of-week phrases in treatment cycles or observances.
modes.example: the patient will start all subsequent cycles on the same<< day>> of the week as the first course.

card.writes: The suppressed tokens are holiday words, so it mainly keeps holiday terms from following; there is no other clear output effect.
card.plain: It notices the little word in phrases like 'days per week' or 'each week' in schedules.
